title: Each active project orchestrator can start autopilot for its root
acceptance: Each project's orchestrator can start swarm autopilot, and it starts go --scope when ready tickets exist, nothing is running, and the cap has room.

title: Ticket manifests declare after-integrated deps without wip branches
acceptance: No orchestrator needs a local wip branch or a hand test run to pass state to a worker.

title: Extract run pipeline from swarm.mjs into swarm-run module
acceptance: swarm.mjs is split into guard, scope, run, integrate, board, spend, lanes and cli modules with no behavior change.

title: Extract argv dispatch from swarm.mjs into swarm-cli module
acceptance: swarm.mjs is split into guard, scope, run, integrate, board, spend, lanes and cli modules with no behavior change.

title: Apply lane byte sizing during split ingest and scope approve warnings
acceptance: scope split --ingest routes an oversize ticket to an in-place lane or refuses with a split hint.
swarm scope approve warns when a ticket exceeds the active lane byte budget.

title: Run wave simulation before scope split --ingest writes the ledger
acceptance: scope split --ingest refuses when simulated critical path exceeds 25% of tickets.
scope split --ingest asks the owner when average wave fill is under half the slot count.

title: Regression tests for delete-only and rename ticket sync
acceptance: A delete-only ticket passes sync once its files are gone.
Rename and migration tickets have their own type with matching checks.

title: Run ticket tests locally with verify agent none and zero model tokens
acceptance: verify mode "local" runs the ticket's tests itself with no agent and no tokens.

title: Default machine worker limit from CPU cores and free RAM
acceptance: The worker limit defaults from cores and free RAM, raises while CPU and RAM allow, and backs off on pressure or lane rate limits.

title: Add Open chat link on each orchestrator card to its Remote Control session
acceptance: Each orchestrator card has an "Open chat" link to its Remote Control session.

title: Wire deploy watch into swarm merge and ship flow
acceptance: swarm deploy watch starts monitoring after a merge-triggered deploy from the project root.

title: Local-only test database cleanup refuses non-localhost targets
acceptance: A cleanup command exits with an error when the database URL host is not localhost.

title: Feed lane pass rates into ticket routing decisions
acceptance: Lane pass rates from field data adjust which lane is chosen for new tickets.
